name: TDspRings
description: Mutable-Instruments-Rings-style modal/string physical-modelling resonator, via the DaisySP (Electrosmith, MIT) ModalVoice + StringVoice DSP. Vendors only the PhysicalModeling chain (modal/string/resonator/KarplusString) + its Filters/Dynamics/Noise/Utility deps. AudioSynthRings wraps a DaisySP voice as a mono int16 AudioStream node; RingsSink is a MidiSink-driven, MPE-aware polyphonic voice pool. Modal + sympathetic-string modes.
